courthouses.name: Glenn County Superior Court (Willows)
courthouses.hours: Clerk's Office Mon–Fri 8:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m. (effective Jan 1, 2025), except holidays
courthouses.note: The court's only listed location — criminal and juvenile delinquency (option 2), traffic/juvenile traffic (option 1), family/civil/dependency (option 4). Juvenile transfer-in hearings 2:00 p.m. on the 2nd & 4th Mondays. Court will appoint the Public Defender for eligible defendants at arraignment. Bench warrant after a missed date: surrender at the court or to law enforcement — call for the day/time.

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Chico Office
legal_aid.serves: Low-income Glenn County residents (housing, public benefits) and Glenn seniors
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid: housing and public benefits (CalWORKs, CalFresh, Medi-Cal, GA, SSI, unemployment); for seniors also consumer, estate planning, POAs, elder abuse. Page does not list criminal or record-clearing help. Walk-ins Mon–Thu; after-hours intake (866) 815-5990.
legal_aid.todo: No free criminal record-clearing provider for Glenn County verified.

probation.name: Glenn County Probation Department
probation.note: Fax (530) 934-6468. Probation performs pretrial risk assessments for the court using the Public Safety Assessment (PSA) tool.

programs.name: Pretrial Services (Probation)
programs.summary: Glenn County Probation is the agency that performs pretrial risk assessments and gives them to the court, using the Public Safety Assessment (PSA). The page does not describe supervision conditions — read your release order.

programs.name: Self-Help Center (SHARP)
programs.summary: Court-supported self-help (family law focus) for unrepresented people; not criminal defense. Mon, Tue, Thu 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. & 12:30–3:30 p.m. at Willows Court Services.

jails.name: Glenn County Jail
jails.phone_note: Number the jail page gives for visiting times for people on administrative separation. Sheriff's Office (543 West Oak Street, Willows): 530-934-6441; 24/7 dispatch 530-934-6431.
jails.note: Visiting: male Tue & Wed 9–12 & 1–4; protective custody Thu 1–4; female Mon 1–4. Money: Smart Deposit online/phone (866-394-0490), lobby kiosk or window Mon–Fri 8–5 (money orders/cashier's checks). No care packs. court_ids: the only courthouse in the county — nearest, not confirmed.
jails.todo: Jail street address not on the jail page (Sheriff's Office is 543 West Oak Street, Willows 95988).

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance license lookup for bail agents (URL carried over from the Orange file; not re-loaded today). Glenn: court links its bail schedule at https://www.glenn.courts.ca.gov/forms-filing/fee-bail-schedules. No online inmate lookup found on county pages; call the Sheriff at 530-934-6441. Glenn County no longer operates a juvenile hall (since June 27, 2017) — detained youth are housed in contracted facilities outside the county; contact Probation 530-934-6416.
